alt: A shophouse street of food stalls and shopfronts under a bright blue sky, lanterns strung overhead
A row of pastel shophouses in yellow and orange, with office towers rising behind them
A long covered walkway at dusk, its handrail lights running in two straight lines to a single vanishing point
Looking straight down a square stairwell, the railings spiralling into the dark, my shoes at the bottom of the frame
Concrete pillars and ceiling beams in a dim car park, lit cold blue
A 'Beware of pedestrians' warning sign on a white wall at night
A narrow street of yellow shophouses and colourful awnings under a grey sky, busy with people
A painted mural of tropical leaves and a robot, seen through an open red window frame
An almost dark auditorium, a few ceiling lights catching rows of empty red seats
